messages:
olivia: Ran a small bring-up for rwd-v8-int5-bridge against our mixed eval harness (n=4.2k). Quick summary: latency wins, cost ~-33%, but a reproducible fidelity delta on the multi-doc synthesis slice.

ben: paste the diffs and CI pls.

olivia: p50 down ~18%, p95 down ~22% on dev-gpu. Hallucination proxy up: baseline rwd-v8-fp16=2.6% -> int5-bridge=4.5% (abs +1.9%, CI +/-0.5%). Agreement with baseline ranking 91.2%.

tara: that's > our 1.0% soft threshold. Any idea which archetypes?

olivia: concentrated on "merge+synthesize from multiple docs" and some instruction-chaining prompts. Not much on short Q/A.

eval-bot: uploaded sample list -> //internal/snapshots/1748609999/int5-bridge-fails.log. Metric snapshot: halluc_est=4.5% (CI 0.5%), baseline=2.6% (CI 0.4%). abs_delta=1.9% (CI LB 1.1%).

ben: CI LB > 1.0% so auto-fallback would have triggered under current gate. Proposed immediate action: pause 5% soft-promote and run a targeted 0.1% canary with shadowing + rerank fallback to baseline for outputs where confidence < 0.75. Also spin hybrid profile: int5 on embed+head, body at fp16.

olivia: Agreed. I'm sketching a gate config for the canary (draft text): target_pct=0.1, duration=24h, metrics=[hallucination_abs_delta(1.0%), agreement_pct(93%), p95_latency_delta_max(60ms)], auto_fallback=true, fallback_policy=route-to-baseline-or-rerank. Include avg-logprob-delta as a soft signal and per-slice CI checks.

ops: deploy-bot queued run: canary(rwd-v8-int5-bridge) @0.1% shadow+rerank, start=2025-04-12T14:00Z. RL ticket will be linked.

ben: Also add a hysteresis rule: don't promote unless two consecutive 24h windows show hall_abs_delta < 0.6% and agreement > 94%. That avoids oscillation.

tara: Good. Add an explicit CI-based immediate alert: if CI lower bound of hall_abs_delta > 0.8% -> emergency rollback and noise channel page.

olivia: I'll cancel the in-flight 5% and file RL-4011. Rollback snippet for playbook: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-4011 && redwood route set default rwd-v8-fp16 && redwood alert create --level incident --tag "canary-halluc"`.

eval-bot: after we run the 0.1% canary, I'll publish per-slice diffs and a small human-reviewed set for the multi-doc slice within 6h of completion.

ben: If hybrid-int5-body-fp16 closes the gap to <0.8% abs delta, we can consider a step-up to 1% with continued rerank. If not, we roll back and iterate on quant kernels.

tara: Also document any kernel-specific regressions (attention kernel path) and attach performance traces. That helps model/infra split root cause.

olivia: Thanks — launching the canary per ops-bot schedule and will ping here with run URL. :rocket:
